_about: Pinned model files for every Conclave reader, for the saved-copy store (GitHub release + home copy, hash-checked). Format follows tools/nestegg/htrlens_models.json. sha256 for HF files is the Hub LFS oid; a null sha256 always carries unmeasured_reason. Weights were not downloaded to make this.
measurement: Hugging Face file sizes + LFS sha256 from the Hub tree API (huggingface.co/api/models/<repo>/tree/<sha>?recursive=true) read 2026-11-23 through a web-fetch tool, because huggingface.co is blocked from the sandbox shell and the HF MCP tool lists sizes without LFS oids; branch/tag shas from /api/models/<repo>/refs. Hashes were transcribed from those responses: the release build must recompute every sha256 and fail on any mismatch. Sizes for the six allowlisted repos were cross-checked byte-for-byte against needed_files.allowlist.json; whole-repo totals were cross-checked against /mnt/project-files/proof_build_0f03c13_measured_sizes.txt.
